mainEntity.name: What factors affect the cost of bow window installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of bow window installation varies based on several key factors. The primary cost drivers include the size and material of the window (e.g., vinyl, wood, fiberglass), the type of glass chosen (e.g., double-pane, low-e, argon gas-filled), and the number of individual window units composing the bow. Additional costs can arise from structural modifications required for the opening, exterior siding repairs, and interior trim work. The chosen hardware and any special finishes also contribute to the overall price. Obtaining detailed quotes based on your specific project is recommended.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors include window size, material, glass type, number of units, structural changes, and interior/exterior finishing work.
